table_a_note: the three repeats share the same 4,200 molecules (only the random partition changes), so the mean/std across repeats is NOT a mean/std across three independent external datasets
table_b_note: delta = RMSE(left) - RMSE(right) on the Validation rows; lower RMSE is better, so a NEGATIVE delta means the left arm is better. The bootstrap interval is a molecule-sampling interval for one frozen seed and is not an estimate of training-seed variance.
table_c_note: smaller sizes are nested prefixes of the frozen order sha256('20261104:<original row id>'); the typed-WL vocabularies always come from the full official Train, so this curve is a labelled-sample-size curve, not a 'only N graphs exist' curve
table_d_note: coverage is computed per role directly from the frozen cached CSR blocks (the last column of each typed-WL block is the OOV bucket); the `coverage` block inside cache/features_manifest.json is the all-4,200-molecule aggregate and is NOT the per-role number. feature_assembly_seconds is the time to assemble one arm/split matrix from cached label-free blocks (hstack + dtype); the one-time tokenisation cost is reported separately because all three splits share it.
